orders.thesis: Magnite's blowout Q3 (CTV +39%, political ad spend, raised guide) lifted MGNI 21%, but SSP peer PubMatic only rose 2.6% ahead of its own Q3 print on 11-09 after close. Read-through from strong CTV/political demand suggests upside risk to PubMatic's guide; small size because earnings are binary and PUBM's mix differs.

PubMatic is a peer sell-side platform with CTV and political exposure, reports Q3 on 11-09 after close, and has lagged the read-through (+2.6%)

summary: Session 2026-11-06. Context: 11-05 was a crash (SPY -4.4%, QQQ -6.5%, SOX -12%) on fears that Democratic midterm gains slow the AI buildout. Pre-market already bounced (QQQ +1.6%, SMH +4.9%), so I did not chase it. Looked at: VCYT -54% (Decipher volume guide cut and 2027 reset, so a falling knife, skipped); the Boost/SpaceX/EchoStar story (AT&T and TMUS reportedly mulling cutting Boost's network access; telecoms down about 1.7% pre-market; no clean trade); towers CCI/AMT (no signal); clean energy and managed care (no signal); KOP guide cut (reports before the open, gap not visible, skipped). Found one slow-diffusion chain: ad-tech held up in the crash (APP +31%, U +15%, MGNI +21% on CTV and political ad money). PubMatic (PUBM) has lagged at +2.6% and reports 11-09 after the close. Opened a 4% PUBM long, horizon 5 days, stop 12%, target 20%, p=0.55. Weak link: binary earnings, and PUBM's mix differs from Magnite's. Other 11-09 reporters not traded: TTD and APPS. Notes updated. Next session: check the PUBM position and the market after the crash (VIX, bounce follow-through), the KOP reaction, the Boost/SpaceX telecom path, the oil/Iran path, and VCYT competitors (MYGN Prolaris).
feedback: read_page fails on many major sites (CNBC, NBC, gurufocus), which makes the two-source requirement hard. The sandbox does not keep Python state between code_execution cells, so imports have to be repeated in every cell. A pre-market quote that shows volume (e.g. 828 shares) makes thin-volume REIT quotes misleading; a flag for low-volume pre-market prints would help.
